statement: Create new content in collections with "Create New Collection"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.
Write document content to disk or pack it into the file in collections with "Export All"; reading it back reproduces the same content, and failures leave the previous file intact.

Create new content in collections with "Add Exporter"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.
Write document content to disk or pack it into the file in collections with "Export"; reading it back reproduces the same content, and failures leave the previous file intact.

Reposition or reshape the current selection in collections with "Move Exporter"; the resulting positions or shapes match Blender 5.3 for the same input, only the selected items change, and one undo step restores them.
Remove or clear content in collections with "Remove Exporter"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Create new content in collections with "Add Importer"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.
Remove or clear content in collections with "Clear Importer"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Bring content into the document in collections with "Import"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.

Run the data operation "Make Importer Local" on the current selection in collections; the resulting data matches Blender 5.3 for the same input, the operation reports a clear error when the input is invalid, and one undo step restores the original.

Bring content into the document in collections with "Reload Importer"; the content is available afterwards with its values intact, missing or broken sources are reported rather than skipped silently, and one undo step reverts the document.
Remove or clear content in collections with "Remove Importer"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Create new content in collections with "Add Selected to Active Object's Collection"; the new item exists in the document afterwards with the values Blender 5.3 gives it, is the active or selected item where Blender makes it so, and one undo step removes it.

Remove or clear content in collections with "Remove from Collection"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Remove or clear content in collections with "Remove Selected from Active Collection"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.

Remove or clear content in collections with "Remove from All Collections"; the targeted data is gone afterwards, unrelated data is untouched, references to it are left valid, and one undo step restores it.
